lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He stood beneath the gray and heavy sky,
She watched the silver garden pass him by,
One spark of gold began to bloom and grow,
They felt the rhythm start to overflow.
[Pre-Chorus]
The cage was open, wide and bright,
They stepped out into the morning light.
[Chorus]
The world is waking in a velvet hue,
Every dream is blooming, fresh and new,
With every heartbeat, a new song begins,
Where the magic ends and the spirit wins.
[Verse]
He found his voice within the garden wall,
She felt the earth begin to rise and call,
No more shadows, no more silent stone,
They claimed a kingdom they could call their own.
[Pre-Chorus]
The garden whispers, soft and deep,
Awakening from a long and frozen sleep.
[Chorus]
The world is waking in a velvet hue,
Every dream is blooming, fresh and new,
With every heartbeat, a new song begins,
Where the magic ends and the spirit wins.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
A sudden mist, a secret hidden trace,
A moment frozen in a sudden grace.
[Chorus]
The world is waking in a velvet hue,
Every dream is blooming, fresh and new,
With every heartbeat, a new song begins,
Where the magic ends and the spirit wins.
[Outro]
